name: fredbet
description: Simple football betting application using Spring Boot, Thymeleaf and Bootstrap. The web pages are constructed in responsive design for using on mobile devices. Default Login - Username: admin | Password: admin - simple betting of football championchips - responsive design (mobile first design) - extra betting of 1st, 2nd and 3rd winner - image gallery (image storage support: filesystem, database) - user profile image - multiple database types supported (H2, MariaDB, MySQL, PostgeSQL) - integrated user administration - rich text editor for rules, prices and misc pages - points statistic - display other users bets after match kickoff - ranking page - Microsoft Excel match import - Microsoft Excel bets, statistic export - language switcher (supported languages: englisch, german, polish, catalan, spanish, swedish) - ranking filter for adults and childs listing - integrated testing capabilities: create demo users, matches, bets... - configurable runtime configuration - use a joker to double your points - self registration (can be disabled) - PDF export of user ranking - Group standings - change UI design themes

variables.name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
variables.description: Active Spring profile at startup. Possible values: h2,dev,maria,mysql,postgres.

variables.name: SPRING_DATASOURCE_DRIVER_CLASS_NAME
variables.description: H2 - org.h2.Driver - h2 | MySQL - com.mysql.jdbc.Driver - mysql | MariaDB - org.mariadb.jdbc.Driver - maria | PostgreSQL - org.postgresql.Driver - postgres
